records.literal_gloss: And answered Balaam and said to Balak, [did] not I speak to you, saying, all that speaks Yahweh, it I will do?

en.L: And Balaam answered and said to Balak, "Did I not tell you, 'All that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} speaks, that I must do'?"
en.B: Balaam answered Balak, "Did I not tell you that I must do whatever {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says?"
en.R: Balaam answered Balak, "I told you before. I must do whatever {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says."

es.L: Y respondió Balaam y dijo a Balac: «¿No te hablé, diciendo: “Todo lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} hable, eso debo hacer”?».
es.B: Balaam respondió a Balac: «¿No te dije que tengo que hacer todo lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} diga?».
es.R: Balaam le respondió a Balac: «Ya te lo dije antes. Tengo que hacer todo lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} diga».

fr.L: Et Balaam répondit et dit à Balak : « Ne t’ai-je pas parlé en disant : “Tout ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dira, je dois le faire” ? »
fr.B: Balaam répondit à Balak : « Ne t’ai-je pas dit que je dois faire tout ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit ? »
fr.R: Balaam a répondu à Balak : « Je te l’ai déjà dit. Je dois faire tout ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit. »

sw.L: Naye Balaamu akajibu, akamwambia Balaki, "Je, sikukuambia, nikisema, 'Yote atakayosema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, hayo ndiyo nipaswayo kuyafanya'?"
sw.B: Balaamu akamjibu Balaki, "Je, sikukuambia kwamba ni lazima nifanye kila {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asemalo?"
sw.R: Balaamu akamjibu Balaki, "Nilikuambia tangu mwanzo. Ni lazima nifanye kila kitu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anachosema."

decisions.choice: did I not tell you ...?: Balaam repeats what he said before
decisions.reason: Balaam said the same to Balak's messengers and to Balak himself (22:18, 20, 38) and after the first oracle (verse 12). The question expects the answer yes.

decisions.choice: I will do: I must do
decisions.reason: The verb form can state what will happen or what must happen. Here it states Balaam's obligation: he has no choice but to do what the LORD says.

decisions.choice: told you that I must do ...
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give Balaam's earlier words as reported speech rather than a quotation inside a quotation.

source.text: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר בָּלָק֙ אֶל־בִּלְעָ֔ם לְכָה־נָּא֙ אֶקָּ֣חֲךָ֔ אֶל־מָק֖וֹם אַחֵ֑ר אוּלַ֤י יִישַׁר֙ בְּעֵינֵ֣י הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים וְקַבֹּ֥תוֹ לִ֖י מִשָּֽׁם׃

records.literal_gloss: And said Balak to Balaam, come, please, let me take you to another place; perhaps it will be right in [the] eyes of the God, and you will curse it for me from there.

en.L: And Balak said to Balaam, "Come, please, let me take you to another place; perhaps it will be right in the eyes of God, and you will curse it for me from there."
en.B: Then Balak said to Balaam, "Come, please, let me take you to another place. Perhaps it will please God to let you curse them for me from there."
en.R: Then Balak said to Balaam, "Please come. I will take you to another place. Maybe God will be willing to let you curse them for me from there."

es.L: Y dijo Balac a Balaam: «Ven, te ruego, te llevaré a otro lugar; quizá parezca bien a los ojos de Dios, y le eches una maldición por mí desde allí».
es.B: Entonces Balac dijo a Balaam: «Ven, por favor, déjame llevarte a otro lugar. Tal vez a Dios le parezca bien que les eches una maldición por mí desde allí».
es.R: Entonces Balac le dijo a Balaam: «Por favor, ven. Te llevaré a otro lugar. Tal vez Dios esté dispuesto a dejarte maldecirlos por mí desde allí».

fr.L: Et Balak dit à Balaam : « Viens donc, que je te conduise dans un autre lieu ; peut-être cela sera-t-il droit aux yeux de Dieu, et de là tu lanceras pour moi une malédiction contre lui. »
fr.B: Alors Balak dit à Balaam : « Viens, je te prie, laisse-moi te conduire dans un autre endroit. Peut-être Dieu trouvera-t-il bon que, de là, tu lances pour moi une malédiction contre eux. »
fr.R: Alors Balak a dit à Balaam : « S’il te plaît, viens. Je vais t’emmener à un autre endroit. Dieu acceptera peut-être que tu les maudisses pour moi de là-bas. »

sw.L: Naye Balaki akamwambia Balaamu, "Njoo, tafadhali, nikupeleke mahali pengine; huenda itakuwa sawa machoni pa Mungu, nawe utamwapiza kwa ajili yangu kutoka huko."
sw.B: Kisha Balaki akamwambia Balaamu, "Njoo, tafadhali, nikupeleke mahali pengine. Huenda Mungu atapendezwa uwaapize kwa ajili yangu ukiwa huko."
sw.R: Kisha Balaki akamwambia Balaamu, "Tafadhali, njoo. Nitakupeleka mahali pengine. Labda Mungu atakubali uwalaani kwa ajili yangu ukiwa huko."

decisions.choice: be right in the eyes of God: be acceptable to God, please him
decisions.reason: "Right in someone's eyes" means pleasing or acceptable to that person (Judges 14:3; 1 Samuel 18:20). Balak still hopes that a new place will change God's mind, though verse 19 has just said that God does not change it.

decisions.choice: and you will curse it for me: the result Balak hopes for
decisions.reason: The clause gives the outcome of God's approval: God will allow it, and Balaam will curse Israel. "It" is the people, as in verse 13.

decisions.choice: Perhaps it will please God to let you curse them
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable join the two clauses, since the curse is what Balak hopes God will allow (m2), and say "them" for the people.

source.text: וַיִּקַּ֥ח בָּלָ֖ק אֶת־בִּלְעָ֑ם רֹ֣אשׁ הַפְּע֔וֹר הַנִּשְׁקָ֖ף עַל־פְּנֵ֥י הַיְשִׁימֹֽן׃

records.literal_gloss: And took Balak Balaam [to the] top of the Peor, which looks down over [the] face of the Jeshimon.

en.L: And Balak took Balaam to the top of Peor, which looks down over the face of the Jeshimon.
en.B: So Balak took Balaam to the top of Peor, which overlooks the Jeshimon.
en.R: So Balak took Balaam to the top of Mount Peor, which looks down on the desert.

es.L: Y llevó Balac a Balaam a la cumbre de Peor, que mira hacia abajo sobre la faz del Jesimón.
es.B: Así que Balac llevó a Balaam a la cumbre de Peor, que domina el Jesimón.
es.R: Entonces Balac llevó a Balaam a la cima del monte Peor, desde donde se ve el desierto.

fr.L: Et Balak conduisit Balaam au sommet de Peor, qui regarde d’en haut la face du Jeshimon.
fr.B: Balak emmena donc Balaam au sommet de Peor, qui domine le Jeshimon.
fr.R: Alors Balak a emmené Balaam au sommet du mont Peor, d’où l’on voit le désert.

sw.L: Naye Balaki akamchukua Balaamu mpaka kilele cha Peori, kinachotazama chini juu ya uso wa Yeshimoni.
sw.B: Basi Balaki alimpeleka Balaamu juu ya kilele cha Peori, kinachoelekea Yeshimoni.
sw.R: Basi Balaki alimpeleka Balaamu juu ya Mlima Peori, unaotazama jangwa.

decisions.choice: Peor: a height in Moab, a place of the worship of Baal
decisions.reason: Peor was a mountain in Moab facing Israel's camp. The god worshiped there was known as Baal of Peor; Israel's sin with him follows in chapter 25, and the town of Beth-peor stood nearby (Deuteronomy 3:29).

decisions.choice: the Jeshimon: the wasteland
decisions.reason: The word means a desert or wasteland. With the article it names a particular dry region, probably the barren land at the north end of the Dead Sea below the heights of Moab, as in 21:20.

decisions.choice: Mount Peor ... the desert
decisions.reason: Readable says that Peor is a mountain and gives the meaning of Jeshimon instead of the name (m2).

source.text: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר בִּלְעָם֙ אֶל־בָּלָ֔ק בְּנֵה־לִ֥י בָזֶ֖ה שִׁבְעָ֣ה מִזְבְּחֹ֑ת וְהָכֵ֥ן לִי֙ בָּזֶ֔ה שִׁבְעָ֥ה פָרִ֖ים וְשִׁבְעָ֥ה אֵילִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And said Balaam to Balak, build for me in this [place] seven altars, and prepare for me in this [place] seven bulls and seven rams.

en.L: And Balaam said to Balak, "Build for me here seven altars, and prepare for me here seven bulls and seven rams."
en.B: Balaam said to Balak, "Build me seven altars here, and get seven bulls and seven rams ready for me here."
en.R: Balaam told Balak, "Build seven altars for me here. Then get seven bulls and seven rams ready for me."

es.L: Y dijo Balaam a Balac: «Constrúyeme aquí siete altares, y prepárame aquí siete novillos y siete carneros».
es.B: Balaam dijo a Balac: «Edifícame aquí siete altares, y tenme preparados aquí siete novillos y siete carneros».
es.R: Balaam le dijo a Balac: «Construye aquí siete altares para mí. Luego prepárame siete novillos y siete carneros».

fr.L: Et Balaam dit à Balak : « Bâtis-moi ici sept autels, et prépare-moi ici sept taureaux et sept béliers. »
fr.B: Balaam dit à Balak : « Construis-moi ici sept autels, et tiens prêts pour moi, ici même, sept taureaux et sept béliers. »
fr.R: Balaam a dit à Balak : « Construis sept autels pour moi ici. Ensuite, prépare-moi sept taureaux et sept béliers. »

sw.L: Kisha Balaamu akamwambia Balaki, "Nijengee hapa madhabahu saba, na uniandalie hapa mafahali saba na kondoo dume saba."
sw.B: Balaamu alimwambia Balaki, "Nijengee madhabahu saba hapa, na uniwekee tayari hapa mafahali saba na kondoo dume saba."
sw.R: Balaamu alimwambia Balaki, "Nijengee madhabahu saba hapa. Kisha uniandalie mafahali saba na kondoo dume saba."

decisions.choice: seven altars, seven bulls, seven rams: the same rite a third time
decisions.reason: As in verse 1. This is the third set of seven altars (verses 1, 14), now on the top of Peor.

source.text: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ בָּלָ֔ק כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר אָמַ֣ר בִּלְעָ֑ם וַיַּ֛עַל פָּ֥ר וָאַ֖יִל בַּמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃

records.literal_gloss: And did Balak just as had said Balaam, and offered up a bull and a ram on the altar.

en.L: And Balak did just as Balaam had said, and offered up a bull and a ram on [each] altar.
en.B: Balak did as Balaam said, and he offered a bull and a ram on each altar.
en.R: Balak did what Balaam said. He offered a bull and a ram on each altar.

es.L: E hizo Balac tal como había dicho Balaam, y ofreció un novillo y un carnero sobre [cada] altar.
es.B: Balac hizo lo que Balaam le dijo, y ofreció un novillo y un carnero en cada altar.
es.R: Balac hizo lo que Balaam le pidió. Ofreció un novillo y un carnero en cada altar.

fr.L: Et Balak fit comme Balaam avait dit, et il offrit un taureau et un bélier sur [chaque] autel.
fr.B: Balak fit ce que Balaam avait demandé, et il offrit un taureau et un bélier sur chaque autel.
fr.R: Balak a fait ce que Balaam avait dit. Il a offert un taureau et un bélier sur chaque autel.

sw.L: Naye Balaki akafanya kama Balaamu alivyosema, akatoa fahali mmoja na kondoo dume mmoja juu ya [kila] madhabahu.
sw.B: Balaki alifanya kama Balaamu alivyosema, akatoa fahali na kondoo dume juu ya kila madhabahu.
sw.R: Balaki alifanya kama Balaamu alivyosema. Akatoa fahali mmoja na kondoo dume mmoja juu ya kila madhabahu.

decisions.choice: on the altar: on each altar
decisions.reason: As in verse 2. This time only Balak is named as the one who offers.
